title: Hawkeri — Hyperlocal Multi-Vendor Commerce Ecosystem
tagline: Real-time inventory sync, COD logistics telemetry, and sub-second checkout across Bangladesh
summary: Engineered an end-to-end multi-vendor marketplace tailored for Bangladesh's dynamic retail fabric, combining low-latency product indexing, Cash-on-Delivery fulfillment tracking, and bilingual search.
architectureHighlight: Edge cached product search · Real-time order dispatch · Optimistic cart state
challenge: High mobile traffic with volatile cellular connectivity, complex district courier logistics, and concurrent vendor catalog updates causing inventory race conditions.
solution: Built a high-performance Next.js storefront backed by edge data caching, local-first cart persistence, and microservice order processing with automated courier routing.

title: AdSkill Consultancy — US Immigration & Visa Guidance Platform
tagline: Specialized guidance platform across US visa & Green Card pathways with 98% success rate
summary: Engineered a high-trust digital intake and consultation scheduling platform for NYC-based US immigration consultancy, featuring automated client triage, 30-min consultation booking, and trust metrics.
challenge: Complex visa assessment forms and lack of trust proof points caused prospective applicants to abandon inquiries before booking initial consultations.
architectureHighlight: Frictionless intake funnels · WhatsApp live triage · Zero-CLS editorial layout
solution: Architected an ultra-fast, data-driven web portal with embedded interactive consultation pipelines, live case success telemetry, and seamless appointment booking.

title: Artisane — Handmade Craft & Atelier Marketplace
tagline: Curated marketplace for stocked craft kits, jewelry making, metalwork, and atelier supplies
summary: Designed and deployed a bespoke e-commerce experience for handmade artisanal crafts, stocked tools, craft storage, and creative studio materials.
challenge: Standard e-commerce frameworks lacked the dark-mode atelier editorial mood while maintaining rapid multi-category search across niche craft inventories.
architectureHighlight: Atelier mood aesthetics · Real-time voucher engine · Instant search telemetry
solution: Crafted an immersive dark editorial marketplace with streamlined category filtering, instant voucher application, and responsive checkout flows.

title: Millat Hossain — Full Stack Developer & Software Engineer Portfolio
tagline: High-performance digital products, scalable frontend systems, and interaction design showcase
summary: Engineered a flagship personal portfolio for Millat Hossain, featuring custom kinetic typography, smooth dark-mode aura aesthetics, interactive work showcase, and resume telemetry.
challenge: Developer portfolios often feel generic and fail to showcase refined interaction craftsmanship alongside engineering depth.
architectureHighlight: Fluid preloader choreography · Dark obsidian aura glow · Interactive work showcase
